gloss: to get a job; to take up a position

definitions.gloss: to get a job; to take up a position; to enter employment
definitions.explanation: To begin working at a job or to assume an occupational position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{職|しょく}に{就|つ}く。
examples.english: I'm starting a job next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{卒業|そつぎょう}→卒業：01643_sotsugyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{職|しょく}に{就|つ}いた。
examples.english: I got a job right after graduating from university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧{職|しょく}に{就|つ}く⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I got a qualification in order to land the job I wanted.

notes:
A somewhat formal expression for starting employment. ⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧ means to assume or take up (a position).

COMMON FORMS:
- {職|しょく}に{就|つ}く: to get/start a job
- {職|しょく}に{就|つ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be employed
- ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}けない→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: unable to get a job

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to find employment (most common, general)
- {職|しょく}に{就|つ}く: to take up a position (slightly more formal)
- ⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work at, to be employed at
- {職|しょく}に{就|つ}く: to get a job (start of employment)
- ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose one's job
- ⟦{職|しょく}→職：00376_shoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}める: to quit one's job

cross_references.label: to work at, to be employed at
